parts.answer: Current AX-17 renal guidance in Germany is detailed by renal category. For Normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD, with a maximum of 100 mg/day and routine monitoring. For Mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD, with a maximum of 100 mg/day and routine monitoring. For Moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the approved German renal starting dose is 25 mg once daily, with a maximum of 50 mg/day and recheck monitoring every 2-4 weeks. For Severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), a specialist review is required, with a maximum dose of 25 mg/day and enhanced monitoring.
